Maya R: Quick sync — planning to flip on per-customer flag for 'advanced-routing' for enterprise customers. Proposed scope: only customers with contract_feature:advanced and tenant_tag 'vip' as initial canary (5 customers). Thoughts? /cc @Ajay K @Liam P

Ajay K: SGTM. Suggest allowlist by contract_id + tenant_tags contains 'vip'. Start with 5 VIPs for 24h. If stable, ramp to 50% of enterprise accounts over 48h, then full. Auto-rollback if 5xx rate spike > 3% or latency p95 > 600ms.

Liam P: From code side the flag lives in ff-service. I'll open a PR to add the gating and telemetry. Who owns the rollout automation (canary -> ramp)?

Sophia T: I'll own the automation. I'll add a rollout job in ops-releases that updates tenant_allowlist and performs the percent ramp. Need a staging preview + a dry-run mode to validate KV routing before we touch prod.

Maya R: Example flag payload (for ops job):

```
{
  "flag_key": "advanced-routing",
  "scope": {
    "contract_ids": ["C-123","C-456","C-789","C-321","C-654"],
    "tenant_tags": ["vip"]
  },
  "rollout": {
    "type": "percent",
    "initial_percent": 0,
    "canary_mode": "allowlist"
  }
}
```

Ajay K: tiny nit: use explicit contract_ids for the initial canary; rely on tags for the 50% ramp. Also add telemetry labels: feature=advanced-routing, rollout=vip-canary.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for ff-service PR #274 at 2025-06-15T22:30Z :rocket:

Liam P: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ff-service/pull/274 — needs review from @Sophia T and @Maya R. Added metrics: ff.feature_eval.latency_ms and ff.feature_eval.error_rate.

Sophia T: Reviewing now. For guardrails, add an automated kill switch: if error_rate > 2% for 5m, disable flag across canary immediately. Also configure alert to page on sustained >1.5% for 10m.

Maya R: Ops checklist:
- [ ] prod preview for 5 customers (Sophia)
- [ ] deploy ff-service PR (Liam)
- [ ] monitor ff.feature_eval.* dashboards (Ajay)
- [ ] confirm contract gating mapping in billing (pinged #customer-success)
- [ ] postmortem template ready if rollback

Ajay K: I'll create the dashboard and set the alerts (pager if error_rate >1.5% sustained 10m). :thumbsup:

Liam P: Addressing CR comments now. ETA ~2h.

Sophia T: Preview in staging done for the 5 VIP customers, routing looks correct, no errors. p95=220ms. :eyes:

Maya R: OK — go for canary tomorrow 22:30 UTC after the deploy window. I'll post a rollout notice to #announcements and send calendar invite for check-in. Thanks all.
